UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated customer profile and alert preferences for R K Gallery & Stationers

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

displayName.description: User display name from Google account

alertsEnabled.description: Whether job and yojana alert notifications are enabled

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

ServiceInquiry.title: ServiceInquiry
ServiceInquiry.description: Customer service or form inquiry submitted to R K Gallery & Stationers

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the inquiry owner

serviceName.description: Selected online service or stationery category

message.description: Optional inquiry details or document notes

SavedBookmark.title: SavedBookmark
SavedBookmark.description: Saved service or job alert bookmarked by the user

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the bookmark owner

itemTitle.description: Title of the saved service or job alert

categoryTitle.description: Category label for the saved item

/users/{userId}.description: User profile and alert preference document scoped by Auth UID

/users/{userId}/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Customer service inquiries owned by the authenticated user

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Bookmarked services and job alerts owned by the authenticated user
